what_changed: Lilly reported Q2 and raised full-year guidance before the 08-05 open after a 5-day drop of 8.6%; opened a LLY long on that catalyst. Crude fell 5-6% on 08-04 on Hormuz reopening hopes, and Trump blasted Exxon and Chevron for making too much money. Copper kept rising to 6.62, near its 1-year high; FCX +9% in 5 days, so the long is held.

oil_gas.why: Hormuz reopening hopes and Trump's pressure on XOM/CVX profits are downside risks; no upside catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Gold bounce on lower yields is priced; the 10-year is near its 1-year high and the jobs report is two-sided.

chips.why: Sharp sector rally is priced; AMD sank after earnings; no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: Q2 results with a full-year guidance raise after an 8.6% pre-earnings drop.

copper_uranium.why: Storm and global supply squeeze in copper persists; copper near its 1-year high.

open_storylines.note: Reuters: Hormuz reopening hopes; WTI 75.8, -20% over 60 days. Re-enter XOM only on renewed closure or tanker attacks with crude not yet repriced.

open_storylines.name: Trump vs oil majors' windfall
open_storylines.note: Trump says Exxon and Chevron are making too much money and demands lower gasoline prices; watch for a windfall tax, export limits or SPR actions (negative for XOM).

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market and rising yields
open_storylines.note: Gold 4153, 22% below its high; the 10-year is 4.63%. Watch the jobs report, the dollar and NEM news.

open_storylines.name: Chip rout and rebound
open_storylines.note: SOXX +8.7% over 5 days; AMD sank after earnings. Watch NVDA earnings in late August, export rules and big-tech capex.

open_storylines.name: US global tariffs and inflation
open_storylines.note: No update today; watch carve-outs for metals and energy, and retaliation.

open_storylines.name: LLY Q2 guidance raise
open_storylines.note: LLY long opened; check the stock's reaction on 08-05 and the size of the raise. Exit if LLY sells off on the print or on drug-pricing news.

open_storylines.note: Copper 6.62, 0.5% off its 1-year high; FCX long. Exit on mine restarts, a dollar rebound or a copper reversal.

open_storylines.note: Uranium ETF +9% over 5 days; Energy Fuels Q2 and producer mid-year updates. Indirect for FCX.
